text:
Marta: Heads-up everyone 5: were opening two small Dedicated G950 pilot pools in Helsinki (HEL) and Calgary (YYC) today. Target: latency-sensitive multilang chat inference. Docs + reservation guidance below. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created pool g950-helsinki (size=8) and pool g950-calgary (size=6)  rollout=rl-2026-g950-01
Theo: Nice. Are these preemptible or part of reserved capacity?
Marta: Pilot phase = invite-only reserved slots for strategic customers + open burst holds. Reservation window = up to 6 days. We will consider full reserved listing after 90 days of telemetry.
billing: Pricing note: pilot surcharge = +12% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Enterprise committed customers can request surcharge review. Use pricing code G950-PILOT in quotes.
Theo: Eviction rules? We saw issues in prior pilots when global rebalancing kicked in.
Marta: Soft-reclaim policy: 45m eviction notice via webhook, plus automatic routing to nearest compatible pool. Weve added an extra migration hook to preserve KV cache where possible.
infra-team: Tagging required: project, region, team (e.g., project=nlpbot region=hel team=prod). Untagged holds auto-cancel after 10h. Nightly cleanup removes stale holds.
eng-oncall: Monitoring rule created: metric pool.g950-*-utilization >= 80% for 12m -> page #eng-oncall. If error_rate > 4% escalate to #infra.
Marta: SLA remains the same for Dedicated. Note in customer-facing docs: "pilot-limited-capacity" caveat.
Theo: Can we get a short CLI snippet for customers/eng teams?
Marta: CLI snippet:
```
# list g950 pools
redwoodctl pools list --filter "g950" --region hel
# reserve 1 GPU for 48h
redwoodctl reservations create --pool g950-helsinki --count 1 --duration 48h --tags project=my-app,team=prod
```
billing: Reminder to sales: disclose surcharge, soft-reclaim policy, and migration expectations when quoting.
Marta: Customer doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/g950-pilot (includes reservation flow, webhook payload example for eviction notices, pricing, SLA caveat). Dashboard link will be added within 2 hours.
infra-team: Ops note: enabling config read-only lock during rollout windows and running extra preflight checks on kernel selection for G950 drivers.
Marta: Thanks all  please escalate anything urgent to #eng-oncall. :pray:
